description.value:
You fuse an unholy spirit into the target, causing it to morph into a visibly horrifying version. The weapon gains the unholy trait and deals an additional 1d4 fire damage on hit. Creatures critically hit by this weapon also become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Heightened (4th) The damage increases to 2d4.

Heightened (6th) The damage increases to 3d4.

Heightened (8th) The damage increases to 4d4.

target.value: 1 tech weapon that’s unattended or wielded by a willing creature
